(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversation_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.conversation_id = conversations.id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversation_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.conversation_id = messages.conversation_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.profile_has_public_vacancy(id))
((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR private.property_has_public_vacancy(id))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1

constraints.name: icon_override_safe_path
constraints.definition: CHECK (((path_d IS NULL) OR (((length(path_d) >= 3) AND (length(path_d) <= 1200)) AND (path_d ~ '^[MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz0-9 .,+-]+$'::text))))
